Q_MAIN.statement: Quadratic main theorem: arbitrary masas admit so-paving with r_epsilon <= 500000000 epsilon^-2, with no expectation or separability hypothesis.

Q_QUOTIENTS.statement: Polynomial quotients have nonnegative arrow residues, a common deletion spectrum, and probability-averaged conditioned residues.

Q_MIXED_BOUNDS.statement: The mixed determinantal upper root bound and two-sign norm lower bound hold with the manuscript's normalization.

Q_ENDPOINTS.statement: Finite-cost endpoints: all-unassigned zero cost and fully-assigned detection of excessive norm.

Q_ASSIGNMENT.statement: For every permitted finite datum, some permanent color at beta=80 has d_v^i-d_v <= 24m_v.

C_PINNING_UNIVERSAL.statement: For arbitrary finite arrow spectra and probability-averaged nonnegative residues, beta>=12 admits a child with positive-trace increase at most 23 times the old first-coordinate positive spectral mass.

P_SPECTRAL_COMPARISON.statement: Prove the two side-arrow trace bounds, positive-trace subadditivity, and diagonal Lipschitz bound, including singular boundaries.

P_RESIDUE_TESTS.statement: Derive both variable-buffer residue tests from positive/negative spectral parts without assuming the target estimate.

P_AVERAGING.statement: Two nonnegative finite probability-averaged tests admit a common positive-probability choice at twice their mean bounds, including zero means.

Q_INVARIANT.statement: Invariant finite-cost limits and rank/deletion comparisons justify weight-cutoff removal.

Q_COLORING.statement: Nonsingular Bernoulli coloring has uniform conditional marginals and the claimed high-probability local norm control.

Q_KERNELS.statement: Off-normalizer operators give atomless kernels under the faithful central-state hypotheses.

Q_TRANSFER.statement: Free compression and mixed moment transfer to actual masa projections hold with modular controls.

Q_COMPLETION.statement: Clipping, continuous calculus, and a spectral cut convert local estimates into the expected-corner so-paving conclusion.

Q_REDUCTIONS.statement: Central-state corner reduction, complementary-corner paving, separable reduction and disjoint-palette assembly preserve the universal count.

A_MAIN.statement: Independent approximation theorem: R(epsilon)<=C_ap epsilon^-6, ||y||<=3||x||, strong approximation and norm paving relative to ||y|| for arbitrary masas.

A_POLYNOMIALS.statement: Stable nonuniform expected determinants have local rooted spectral probabilities and spectral-shift costs.

A_INITIAL_ROOT.statement: The zero-diagonal contraction uniform-color expected polynomial has largest root <=2sqrt(2/r)+2/r.

A_BUFFERED_PIN.statement: Buffered pinning controls child deletion length by old length plus a universal multiple of rooted mass.

A_MEASURED.statement: Slab comparisons, coherent color choices, sparse updates and deletion yield one-sided measured paving.

A_EXPECTED.statement: Central-state masa approximation paving follows from measured paving, atomless kernels, nontracial random freeness and free compression.

A_GENERAL.statement: Separable and three-corner reductions remove expectation assumptions while norming and clipping preserve relative error against the approximant's own norm.
